- The environment login's provider button (`Continue with` plus the provider name) and the `or continue with email` divider, in `packages/auth/src/SocialSignInButtons.tsx` and its callers `LoginForm.tsx` / `RegisterForm.tsx`.
- The `Build Doctor` button and drawer title, in `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` and `BuildDebugDrawer.tsx`.
- The environment Setup → marketplace breadcrumb `Marketplace` and the zh search placeholder's `manifest ID` jargon, in `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/**` and the `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` keys they read.
- Tests pinning each surface under zh-CN with English as the default, and a `patch` changeset.

The English source stays the default, per the card's acceptance. ⛔ Cloud-owned strings stay on objectstack-ai/cloud#2435.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT, objectstack `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12692` at `7db1332f`)
Clause-②: no
Why no: display strings and locale entries only; no schema, spec, published type or accepted document changes.
Thread-read: 5864728339
Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-28T08:58Z at objectui `origin/main` `29c76e573`.
- PR objectui#10924 (epic objectui#10899) holds `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` and all ten locale files. The dev maps its hunks and keeps every new key and edit at least 5 lines clear of them; any overlap is a stop.
- PRs objectui#10910 and #10911 are in the merge queue with locale edits, and PR objectui#10914 is in the queue with comment-only lines in `ActionRunner.ts`. The dev merges `origin/main` before pushing, if they have landed by then.

## Claim amended: `Clause-②` reads yes · `domain:ui` seat #1 · 2026-09-28T10:53Z

`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk` (`os-steve`). This amends claim `5866735286`, after the dev report on PR objectui#10953.

Clause-②: yes

**Why yes.** The claim read `no` on the premise of strings only. Measured on the PR head `f6582636f`, the repair widens published surface additively, by four optional members:
- `ActionRunner.setTranslator` in `@object-ui/core`. `@object-ui/core` cannot import the translator, because `@object-ui/i18n` depends on core; so the runner's fallback toast takes an injected translator, which `ActionProvider` and `useActionRunner` install.
- `SocialSignInButtonsProps.buttonText`, `LoginFormLabels.socialButton` and `RegisterFormLabels.socialButton` in `@object-ui/auth`. That package's string channel is the forms' `labels` prop.

Nothing narrows. The seat takes the dev's recommendations on both of its open questions:
- **A**: the body keeps `Clause-②: yes`.
- **A**: the changeset keeps `minor` for `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/auth`, and `patch` for the four other packages touched, following the repository's precedent for an additive widening.

**Surface.** The claim's file list also widens by `packages/react` (the two runner owners that install the translator) and `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`. The marketplace breadcrumb is rendered there, not under `console/marketplace/**`, as the claim had assumed.

**Consequence.** `needs:contract-review` hangs on this card and on the PR in this stroke. An at-tier Clause-② review PASS is owed before the PR is readied or queued.
